description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pyrotechnic Performer, adding {R}.
When Pyrotechnic Performer dies, Yedora triggers, returning Pyrotechnic Performer from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Pyrotechnic Performer by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pyrotechnic Performer's disguise ability by paying {R}, turning it face-up.
Pyrotechnic Performer triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to each opponent.
Repeat.
